description: Source code for Mattermost's mmctl command-line tool, including client initialization, version checking, certificate verification, and command prechecks.

methods.name: CheckVersionMatch
methods.description: Checks if the provided client version matches the server version based on semantic versioning rules.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Initializes and returns a Mattermost API client, determining local or remote mode based on configuration.

methods.name: withClient
methods.description: Decorator that manages client creation, version validation, and error handling for command execution.

methods.name: localOnlyPrecheck
methods.description: Precheck to ensure command runs only in local mode.

methods.name: disableLocalPrecheck
methods.description: Precheck to ensure command does not run in local mode.

methods.name: VerifyCertificates
methods.description: Verifies the certificate chain for insecure algorithms.

methods.name: InitClientWithUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Initializes a client with username and password authentication.

methods.name: InitClientWithMFA
methods.description: Initializes a client with MFA authentication.

methods.name: InitClientWithCredentials
methods.description: Initializes a client using stored credentials.

methods.name: InitClient
methods.description: Initializes a client using current stored credentials.

methods.name: InitWebSocketClient
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket client for real-time communication.

methods.name: InitUnixClient
methods.description: Creates a Unix socket client for local server communication.
